        Right in the sweet spot !!
        Reviewed in India on 1 May 2026
        Colour: Charcoal BlackSize: 12GB+256GB
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        Great phone in terms of 3 key pillars

        -Blazing fast performance and UI

        -Display and

        -Battery 7400 mah Silicon carbon with 80w charger in the box

        Camera is avg/good.

        Ticks all the right boxes - fast charger in the box , great speed and performance, excellent display for multi media experience , bloat free UI and great connectivity. I’m not a camera person so for me this ticks all the right boxes.

        Don’t have to worry about the battery by eod easily last the full day which is a very big plus when compared to my iPhone 17. 7400 mah is quiet a monster and it charges fast too.

        I also use this phone a lot for hotspot never had any issues even after very very heavy days

        Pros - performance - very fast and doesn’t heat up . I don’t game much but use the phone heavily for trading , hotspot and work

        Comes with a good charger , screen guard and a case ( you don’t have to spend money on those basic things for starters unlike apple and Samsung)

        Good build quality and almost bezel less display with good Oled screen.

        Cons -

        Things missing which don’t bother me but could bother some users -

        No eSIM support - can be an issue for people who travel a lot

        No wireless charging - I don’t even use it for my iPhones so it doesn’t bother me.

        Average cameras - low light performance not good .

        Display is not LTPO so works 60-120 hz doesn’t go down to 0 hz like apple ( it doesn’t bother me at all tbh)

        Could have been priced aggressively but the current geo political situation this will be the new pricing trend !!

        Conclusion the phone beats everything else in this price range.

I chose this overall iQOO 15r & Poco X8 Pro Max due the OS stability (ads free & feature loaded) and overall brand reliability. I have used Realme, Xiaomi, Moto & Samsung.         Reason being if anytime I need to replace screen or anything then fixing 1+, realme & Samsung have the best availability and repairability. So after sales is very important which brand like Samsung, Oneplus & Realme comes to top place.

        4 out of 5 stars
        A really good phone which tries to meet everyone's expectations and in budget.
        Reviewed in India on 31 December 2025
        Colour: Mint BreezeSize: 12GB+256GB
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        Got this beauty on Dec 23. Upgraded from iqoo3( yes, the first iqoo phone in India) after almost 5 years. Must say the previous one really held its ground.Coming back to 15r, this is pretty good upgrade as I am not very frequent camera user and gaming was my major priority. This phone really delivers on that front. Performance is smooth and you can get 110-115 avg fps in bgmi. Battery at 7400 mah is a really good, no complaints there. Camera is pretty good as well for the price. It has the same primary camera as the oneplus 15. Gives amazing results in daylight. If you know a little about photography then you can make a good use of this camera as well. UI is smooth and haptics are a little weak but not a deal breaker. Overall this phone is bang for the buck.         True review from OnePlus loyalist
        Reviewed in India on 24 April 2026
        Colour: Charcoal BlackSize: 12GB+256GB
        Verified Purchase
        Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
        Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

        I’m a bit of a OnePlus loyalist. Ever since I got my first 7T back in January 2020, I haven't even looked at another brand. Now that I’ve moved up to the OnePlus 15R, I’ve got some thoughts for anyone else thinking of making the jump.

        How it feels in the hand:

        First off, the look and feel is just solid. It doesn't feel like a cheap piece of plastic; the back has this really unique texture that feels great when you're holding it. It actually looks different from all the other phones out there, which I really like.

        Performance & Camera:

        The performance is just awesome—super fast and smooth. If you’re like me and not a "pro" photographer but still want your photos to look crisp and clear, the camera is perfect. It’s great for everyday shots and looks really high-quality without having to mess with a bunch of settings.

        The Battery Situation:

        Okay, here is the honest truth. It’s got a huge 7,400mAh battery.

        The Good:

        It lasts me about 1.5 days. It’s very reliable, though I’ll admit I expected a tiny bit more juice for a battery that size.

        The Critique:

        OnePlus was kind enough to put the 80W charger and a case in the box (thank you!), but honestly, for a battery this big, they really should have given us a 100W charger. 80W is fast, but when you're charging a 7,400mAh tank, you want that extra speed!

      About this Item

      • World's first Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 - The OnePlus 15R unchains the soul of a dragon. Paired with LPDDR5X Ultra and UFS 4.1, the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 is a lightning storm of benchmark-breaking power — every swipe instant, your app explodes open, and 120 FPS gaming is truly silky-smooth.
      • Tri-Chips for Ultimate Performance - With a blazing 165 Hz refresh rate, the OnePlus 15R features the OP Gaming Core engine, a dedicated G2 Wi‑Fi chip and a high‑speed touch‑response chip for ultra‑low latency and flawless control.
      • Impossibly Smooth - 165Hz Display - Witness the 165Hz, 1.5K flagship display perfected for lightning-fast visuals that flow
      • Power Up Not Down - Our largest-ever 7,400mAh battery powers your unplugged life. Plus, with Bypass Charging, you can keep gaming all the way to the victory screen—stay powered up without powering down.
      • Meet Plus Mind - The world’s first AI tool built to work seamlessly with Gemini. It intelligently captures, organizes, and recalls everything you see, so every idea, date, or detail is always within reach. Plan trips, surface information from screenshots, and relive moments effortlessly — all from your Mind Space app, powered by OnePlus AI.
      • Backed by the industry's most complete IP ratings - With IP66/68/69/69K , the OnePlus 15R doesn't even blink at dust storms, and shrugs off powerful water blasts.
      • Ultra Clear Photography with DetailMax Engine. - The OnePlus 15R’s camera is powered by our most advanced computational photography engine. Pixel-perfect detail, expansive vistas, and crystal-clear portraits breathe with life.
      • Surf. Stream. Repeat - From blazing daylight to a midnight low of 1 nit with Reduce White Point, the TÜV Rheinland-certified display reduces eye strain and flicker for visuals that wow without worry.
